text:
devon: Heads-up — release-bot alerted on a spike of 5xxs from eu1 for /v1/stream. PR #3891 (release/v1.2.9-hotfix) fixes kvcache NPE, needs expedited deploy during the change window. Requesting quick consensus to pin and skip canary.
release-bot: ALERT: 5xx rate 2.8% over 3m on eu1. Error sample: "kvcache: nil pointer deref". Suggested action: deploy hotfix image redwood/serve:v1.2.9-hotfix to eu1.
maria: How bad is traffic right now? can we wait for the low-traffic 30m window at 00:30 UTC?
sanjay: Traffic on eu1 is trending down but errors are increasing. stacktrace points to race in cache init — hotfix is safe and tiny. If we wait errors will keep impacting live users.
liz: oncall — any constraints? skipping canary ok if stakeholders +1 and we have rollback criteria + short watch.
oncall: I can cover watch. No objection to expedited deploy, but require smoke tests and 15m watch, and rollback trigger: sustained >1% 5xx for 5m or tail latency >500ms at p95.
jordan: +1 from infra for pin. Also add a config to force fallback to CPU path if kvcache fails.
devon: deploy-bot, please prepare a no-canary rollout and patch notes. Command we plan to run: ```/deploy --env=eu1 --image=redwood/serve:v1.2.9-hotfix --no-canary --annotate "hotfix-kvcache-npe"```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Received deploy request by devon. Preparing rollout artifacts. Canary disabled per flag. Posting CI link: https://ci.redwood.dev/3891/run/11
release-bot: NOTE: tagging release as "hotfix: eu1 kvcache NPE". Change window exception recorded.
maria: quick question — do we pin pool or set routing fallback? pin to eu1 pool to avoid noisy routing.
devon: pinning to eu1 pool v=1.2.9-hotfix now.
release-bot: START: Deploy to eu1 pool. Instances: rolling update 3 -> 3.
release-bot: LOG: pre-deploy smoke passed on staging, now applying to prod eu1.
(2m pass)
release-bot: UPDATE: deploy completed to 100% eu1. Initial metrics: 5xx dropped to 0.7% but p95 latency spiked to ~620ms for 3m.
sanjay: Hmm latency spike >500ms p95 for 3m — matches rollback criteria if sustained 5m. Watch closely another 2m.
jordan: Not seeing the kvcache errors anymore in logs, but upstream redis connections show a transient reconnect that could explain latency.
liz: If latency persists >500ms at p95 for another 2m we should rollback. Any easy toggles?
devon: I can trigger immediate rollback if it doesn't improve. Rolling window at 2m.
(2m pass)
release-bot: ALERT: p95 still ~610ms over last 2m and user-facing errors creeping back from upstream. Triggering rollback as per consensus.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK: initiating rollback to redwood/serve:v1.2.8 across eu1. Command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/serve --namespace=prod --to-revision=7`
release-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE: eu1 at v1.2.8. Post-rollback metrics: 5xx down to 0.2%, p95 ~210ms.
oncall: Good call to rollback. I'll keep the incident open for a brief blameless postmortem and make sure runbook steps are captured.
maria: Please add the change-window exception note and that canary was intentionally skipped for this hotfix. Also add steps for adding redis reconnect backoffs in the follow-up PR.
sanjay: I'll open follow-up PR to add reconnect backoff and more conservative cache-init guard.
devon: Thanks everyone. We'll schedule a 30m postmortem doc and add the hotfix release notes: "v1.2.9-hotfix: addressed kvcache NPE; rolled back due to p95 latency spike; follow-ups required for redis backoff and cache guardrails." :thumbsup:
liz: tagging eng leads for visibility. Thanks for quick responses.
release-bot: INCIDENT: hotfix/deploy/4359876500 closed. Change-window exception persisted in audit log.
(threads ends)
